$comment: Candidate gemini detection rules, verified against real panes by harness-bench.test.ts before they are published. These are DATA for the OTA manifest (zeph/apps/server/src/agent-rules/manifest.json), not bundled rules — agent-rules.default.ts stays empty for gemini so a listener that cannot reach the endpoint keeps reporting `unknown` rather than guessing. Authored from panes captured for this repo (Gemini CLI v0.46.0); no rule content is carried over from any other project.
$coverage: KNOWN GAP — `blocked` here means the folder-trust dialog, the only blocked screen that was actually captured. Gemini's tool-approval prompt is the common blocked case in practice and has NO rule: the probe session had shell auto-approved, so it never rendered. Until someone captures it, a gemini session waiting on tool approval reports `working` (the spinner rule) or `idle`, not `blocked`. Do not read the bench matrix's green `blocked` cell as full coverage of that state.
